Apologies for the delay, needed some free time to test this out.

By default Jackett uses the Local System account, whereas credentials are saved as the current user, so by changing the service to run as the current user, Jackett now has access to said credentials.

This is what worked for me:

- access the UNC path in Windows Explorer if you haven't already (e.g. `\\ServerName\Jackett\Download`), entering the required credentials, and ticking the option to remember them
- these will now be saved to the Windows Credentials Manager for your Windows account
- open Services, double-click the Jackett service, stop the service if running, click the `Log On` tab, click the `This account` option, select your Windows account, enter and confirm your account password, apply, restart the service
- access/refresh the Jackett webUI in browser, enter the UNC path as the Blackhole directory, and apply server settings

Why did you have to add the indexer as new today?\
\
Use a VPN or proxy, try to add the indexer, change it to the \*.download domain, click `Okay`. If it fails, close the config panel and try again, the \*.download domain should already be set and you may need to enter the captcha. You then no longer need to use a VPN or captcha.\
\
Alternatively, create a `lostfilm.json` file in the Indexers folder (or copy another and rename the copy), then add the following and save the file:\
\
```\
[\
  {\
    "id": "sitelink",\
    "type": "inputstring",\
    "name": "Site Link",\
    "value": "https://www.lostfilm.download/"\
  }\
]\
```\
\
You can then restart the Jackett container and reconfigure the indexer with your email, password, and possibly also a captcha.\

Not possible.\
\
The Jackett GitHub repo is a free public repo which means we get allocated a set amount of CPU time to build packages with.\
\
If we started adding more of the different flavours of linux builds we would exceed our monthly quota and not be able to publish anything until the next month.\
\
For this reason we stick to the standard 10 builds LinuxAMDx64.tar.gz, LinuxARM32.tar.gz, LinuxARM64.tar.gz, LinuxMuslAMDx64.tar.gz, LinuxMuslARM32.tar.gz, LinuxMuslARM64.tar.gz, macOS.tar.gz, macOSARM64.tar.gz, Mono.tar.gz, Jackett.Installer.Windows.exe to keeps us under our quota.\
\
Other flavours are supported by other 3rd parties.\
